compatibility_contract.s0_invocation: The approved S0 command without --profile keeps RepositorySnapshotV1 and CodeNoesisErrorV1 behavior.
compatibility_contract.s1_invocation: The explicit --profile standard-local-s1 command keeps RepositorySnapshotV2 and CodeNoesisErrorV2 behavior.
compatibility_contract.s2_invocation: Only the explicit --profile standard-local-s2 command selects RepositorySnapshotV3 and CodeNoesisErrorV3.

extraction_contract.input: bounded committed UTF-8 .rs blobs from the approved S1 inventory
extraction_contract.crate_shape: exactly one src/lib.rs library root with inline modules for the S2 fixture
extraction_contract.output: one ordered ExtractionChunkV1 per eligible Rust blob

graph_contract.publication: all-or-nothing after schema, identity, endpoint, cardinality, reachability, claim, derivation, ordering, and hash validation

identity_contract.path_normalization: none; preserve approved S1 UTF-8 bytes
identity_contract.collision_behavior: typed extraction.normalization_collision with no ordinal repair or partial publication

malformed_and_unicode_contract.malformed_recovery: emit only subjects whose complete supporting spans are disjoint from every bounded ERROR or MISSING region
malformed_and_unicode_contract.malformed_reporting: one extraction.malformed_syntax diagnostic and malformed_syntax_excluded gap per ordered region
malformed_and_unicode_contract.unsafe_recovery: typed extraction.malformed_syntax with no partial snapshot
malformed_and_unicode_contract.source_spelling: preserved in display_name and exact byte evidence
malformed_and_unicode_contract.unresolved_symbol: rust.symbol_reference with resolution unresolved and an explicit coverage gap; never a guessed internal link

expected_red.precondition: The future TDD branch contains the black-box S2 harness and reviewed fixture while production remains at merged S1 behavior.
expected_red.runner_expected_exit: nonzero because the acceptance assertion fails
expected_red.accepted_reason: Merged S1 recognizes --profile but rejects standard-local-s2, so the approved S2 public behavior is absent.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize fixture revision A as verified loose SHA-1 objects under the inherited S1 boundary.
scenarios.act: Run the exact public S2 command with the full commit OID.
assert: Exit is 0, stderr is empty, and stdout is one strict RepositorySnapshotV3 plus LF.
The inherited inventory, extraction chunk, graph, counts, ordering, IDs, claims, evidence, gaps, and hashes equal the reviewed oracle.
No absolute path, worktree content, volatile value, or unsupported semantic assertion enters the canonical graph.

scenarios.arrange: Start from the valid reviewed extraction chunk and independently mutate each field, type, identity, span, order, reference, and claim.
scenarios.act: Validate the strict schema and cross-document extraction invariants.
assert: The reviewed chunk passes.
Every missing, unknown, duplicate, dangling, out-of-range, derived-state, or forbidden-relationship mutation fails before graph ingestion.
No rejected chunk contributes a partial entity or relationship.

scenarios.arrange: Load the exact source bytes, ontology table, and expected graph A.
scenarios.act: Extract and normalize the supported Rust surface.
assert: All eleven entities, fifteen relationships, twenty-six claims, thirteen evidence records, and three coverage gaps match exactly.
The graph includes the inline module, types, functions, imports, trait implementation, and Unicode function without fields, variants, calls, or guessed links.
The graph semantic hash is 75511bc1b6f4852945406f0222ff5e11b6139431d644d83a12c527b923c257cd.

scenarios.arrange: Generate the manifest's reviewed section-sign token insertion.
assert: The exact malformed byte span produces one stable diagnostic and one coverage gap.
Only complete subjects disjoint from the malformed region may remain.
No node, relationship, or evidence span is invented from the malformed region.

scenarios.arrange: Append the canonically equivalent decomposed cafe-plus-combining-acute function from the manifest.
scenarios.act: Normalize identifier components to NFC before identity construction.
assert: Exit is 11 with the reviewed CodeNoesisErrorV3 extraction.normalization_collision.
Both exact source spans and the one normalized identity are reported without source excerpts.
No ordinal, byte offset, source order, or partial graph resolves the collision.

scenarios.arrange: Generate at least fifty entity, relationship, chunk, map-insertion, evidence-discovery, scheduler, and unrelated-commit permutations.
scenarios.act: Recompute every canonical preimage and BLAKE3 identifier independently.
assert: All entity, relationship, and claim IDs equal the reviewed golden.
An unrelated commit or source-offset change preserves symbol IDs while evidence remains revision-specific.
Changing repository identity, kind, normalized symbol identity, relationship endpoint, or ontology version changes the applicable ID.

scenarios.arrange: Mutate the valid graph across kind/property matrices, endpoints, duplicate tuples, cardinalities, reachability, cycles, claims, evidence, ordering, and hashes.
assert: The reviewed graph passes and every non-equivalent invalid mutation returns its stable graph error.
Exactly one crate, one file container, one declaration owner, endpoint closure, claim uniqueness, and DEFINES reachability always hold.
Validation order selects one deterministic first failure.

scenarios.arrange: Enumerate every ordered pair over the seven claim states plus same-state requests and each origin policy.
scenarios.act: Apply the approved transition and origin model.
assert: Exactly the eleven listed transitions pass.
Same-state requests and every unlisted transition fail with graph.invalid_claim_transition.
Parser, rule, model, Council, and confirmation origins cannot emit a forbidden state.

scenarios.arrange: Load the crate and source-file claims in both orders and mutate rule version, inputs, evidence, cycles, and input states.
assert: The exact derived CONTAINS claim and ID replay from the same inputs.
The output retains the rule version, both input claim IDs, and supporting evidence.
Missing, duplicate, cyclic, dangling, or state-incompatible dependencies fail with graph.invalid_derivation.

scenarios.arrange: Seed structured mutations from every valid and invalid extraction, graph, claim, evidence, malformed, and Unicode oracle case.
scenarios.act: Fuzz decoding and validation under inherited S1 resource ceilings.
assert: No panic, hang, unbounded allocation, partial publication, or accepted invalid contract occurs.
Every retained failure records seed, digest, stable outcome, and minimized reproducer.
Seed corpus changes require human review of semantic meaning.

scenarios.arrange: Seed valid source, malformed token, Unicode collision, nesting, token amplification, and unsupported syntax cases.
scenarios.act: Parse bounded committed bytes without invoking repository tooling.
assert: Every input terminates inside inherited wall, CPU, RSS, output, and file limits.
Malformed or unsupported syntax is typed or explicitly covered and never fabricated as resolved meaning.
No crash or nondeterministic semantic output occurs.

scenarios.arrange: Use inherited S0/S1 process, network, filesystem, and sentinel observers while scanning the fixture and generated parser cases.
scenarios.act: Run the complete S2 public path.
assert: Zero child process, exec, network, outside-root, dirty-worktree, or repository-controlled code event occurs.
Cargo.toml is inventoried but Cargo, rustc, build scripts, and procedural macros are never invoked.
Observer self-tests and inherited sentinels remain Green.

scenarios.arrange: Start from the reviewed graph and collision error, construct the V3 snapshot, and generate one-field and cross-reference mutations.
scenarios.act: Validate schemas, compatibility dispatch, semantic hashes, errors, and graph invariants.
assert: Reviewed documents pass and every missing, unknown, reordered, dangling, out-of-range, incompatible-version, or wrong-hash mutation fails.
S0 and S1 commands remain byte-compatible with their approved fixtures.
No error leaks absolute paths, source excerpts, environment data, or partial artifacts.

evidence_contract.red: Retain the first expected failing runner log before production changes, with base and pre-implementation SHAs, runner and subject exits, V2 stderr code, command, environment, SHA-256, and immutable artifact locator.
evidence_contract.green: Retain one ordered passing result for every S2 scenario and inherited S0/S1 regression, with command, exit status, report digest, and immutable artifact locator.
evidence_contract.identity: Retain independent preimages and BLAKE3 results for every reviewed entity, relationship, claim, graph, chunk, configuration, and snapshot hash.
evidence_contract.parser: Retain grammar and adapter versions, valid/malformed/Unicode outputs, fuzz seeds and minimized reproducers, cancellation and resource reports.
evidence_contract.security: Retain inherited process/network/filesystem observer self-tests, traces, root identity, denied and unresolved counts, sentinel result, and resource report.
environment: Tree-sitter Rust crate and grammar versions
network namespace and seccomp profile digest
evidence_contract.retention: Every required log, report, seed, and reproducer remains retrievable and digest-valid for at least 90 days.
evidence_contract.verification_rule: Local evidence may support review but cannot set Verified without immutable retained CI artifacts for the exact head.

out-of-line module and Cargo feature/configuration-world resolution
fields, variants, constants, statics, generics, lifetimes, macros, closures, and expressions
glob imports, aliases, re-exports, extern prelude, and compiler-grade name or type resolution
inherent implementations, anonymous targets, calls, reads, writes, and data flow

stop_conditions: The protected contract differs from the approved bundle.
The first Red is absent or fails for a reason other than standard-local-s2 being rejected by merged S1.
A stable identity, normalization collision, endpoint matrix, cardinality, transition, derivation, malformed span, or first-failure rule is ambiguous.
Any supported fixture behavior requires Cargo, rustc, macro expansion, target execution, network, dirty-worktree access, or compiler-grade guessing.
A parser case cannot terminate inside inherited S1 boundaries or deterministic recovery cannot be established.
S0 or S1 regressions fail or their public dispatch changes.
The task exceeds its allowed paths, high-risk scope, resource budget, or two bounded correction attempts.
